elements.text:
When / owner	Action	Output / acceptance
Weeks 1-2
Transformation lead + Sales	Interview all roles; map demand to production; nominate a Sales product owner	Value-stream map; agreed priorities; named owners; baseline queue times
Week 2
Dev + Test + Ops leads	Create a pilot squad: 2 developers, 1 tester, 1 Ops engineer; Sales owns priorities	Squad charter; shared definition of done; release responsibility accepted
From week 2
Pilot squad	Use one Kanban board; start with WIP <= 3 active changes; unblock work daily	Each change has owner and acceptance criteria; weekly review of aging work

elements.name: table-footnote
elements.text: Suggested tools: a shared issue board and wiki. Retain existing tools if they satisfy the requirements.
